section_summary.extract_value: This section presents mediation analyses examining how body esteem (attitudes toward performance and appearance) and body orientation (body-as-process and body-as-object) mediate the relationships between body-related talk (exercise talk and weight-loss/diet talk) and body appreciation. Results indicate that body esteem fully mediates the relationship between exercise talk and body appreciation, while body orientation partially mediates this relationship; for weight-loss/diet talk, only attitudes toward appearance partially mediate the relationship with body appreciation.
